verdict.rationale: Alacritty's user data is mainly its configuration, which is stored in the open TOML format and can be split into imported files. That makes it portable without any proprietary export step. Beyond config, the evidence shows only keyboard/mouse selection and copy of scrollback text, with no dedicated export of session or scrollback data. Missing for 10: an explicit data-export or migration feature, a documented scrollback/session export in an open format, and independent corroboration of portability.
